raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 144 extra rows that re-deliver txn_ids already loaded in earlier batches, at batch boundaries (overlapping id ranges between consecutive batches), and silver_transactions does not deduplicate them. The fix keeps only the latest delivery per txn_id (highest batch_id, then ingest_ts) before applying the POSTED filter, so a later REVERSED re-delivery correctly removes the transaction instead of leaving a stale POSTED copy.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY batch_id DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE d.rn = 1 AND d.status = 'POSTED';"}}
